name: autoGear
tagline: Recommends the next office-equipment upgrade with an explainable score and live prices.
problem: People on a budget upgrade the wrong thing first or face too many options.
solution: Captures a desk inventory by lookup or a browser video scan, ranks upgrades with a deterministic formula, explains each with Gemma and pulls current retail prices.
demo_moment: Team-described: scan a desk and see ranked upgrades with explanations.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Keeps ranking deterministic and uses the model only to explain.

lessons: Separate the scoring from the explanation so the advice is checkable.
